questions: Should the random strings be generated with replacement (i.e., each character independently chosen from VALID_CHARACTERS) or without replacement (no repeats within a string)?
Is the random generation seeded or deterministic? Should the function accept a seed parameter or rely on external seeding?
Should the dictionary keys be characters (strings of length 1) or something else (e.g., integer codes)?
If n_strings or string_length is zero, should the function return an empty dictionary or handle it differently?
Are the input parameters guaranteed to be non-negative integers, and should the function validate or handle negative values?
Should the dictionary be sorted or ordered in any specific way (e.g., by character, by frequency)?
Is the function expected to be thread-safe or reentrant (e.g., using a local random instance)?
Should the function count characters across all strings combined, or return separate counts per string?
